goal_intent: book Friday for two, then correct the time when you hear it read back wrong

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m calling because I’m planning a little get-together for the end of the week—just two of us. Could I book a table for Friday?
Thanks so much! We were thinking 7pm would be perfect—it lets us catch up after work and maybe enjoy the nice weather. I can give you my name if you need it.
Sure, it's Iwan Prosser. And thanks for checking—looking forward to a cosy dinner for two at seven!
Actually, sorry, could you make that eight o'clock instead? We realized we’d need a bit more time beforehand. No special requests, just a regular table for two at 8pm this Friday, please!
No, that’s perfect—thanks so much for sorting that out! Looking forward to Friday. Have a great day! [END OF CALL]
